description:
Follow-up to closed JMAP-zk6m.4. The field crate-jmap-tasks-types/src/notification.rs:88 is currently:

    /// A patch encoding the change between `task` and the state after
    /// the update. Encoded as a PatchObject (RFC 8620 §5.3).
    pub task_patch: Option<serde_json::Value>,

Doc says 'Encoded as a PatchObject'; type is Value. Like CalendarEventNotification.event_patch, this is a notification *payload* field, not an *update argument*, which is why the closed PatchObject adoption epic JMAP-zk6m.4 did not migrate it.

Proposed change (jmap-tasks-types/src/notification.rs:88):

    pub task_patch: Option<jmap_types::PatchObject>,

Wire format unchanged (PatchObject is #[serde(transparent)]). Public API change: any caller pattern-matching on the field type or constructing TaskNotification from a Value literal must migrate.

## Scope

- 1 line change + import in jmap-tasks-types/src/notification.rs.

## Acceptance criteria

'cargo test --workspace' clean, lib clippy clean, wire format byte-identical.

## Coordination

Should land alongside the parallel calendars-types migration (separate bead) so the two notification structs stay typographically congruent. The mail-types parallel field (MdnSendRequest.on_success_update_email) has a separate LOCKED approval gate.
notes: Re-opened 2026-05-09 after the wider-scope survey identified 5 additional sibling fields. Now a child of parent epic JMAP-trmz. See epic for full sweep context.
title: Migrate TaskNotification::task_patch to typed PatchObject
